versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Hares' buffs all vanish at each New Moon on a visible four-turn Moon cycle, so they stack and double light for big Full Moon turns.
The reset can be cashed in as gold, passed to non-Hares who keep it, or sped up by Waxing the Moon.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Clearer wording: Leveret, Three Ears and Silverpenny now say exactly what they do, and the shelf-life line matches the clock.
Charm-Pedlar pays once a turn to stop a gold loop; Spring-Ring Jill rewards the New Moon, and Jacks get a label.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
The Hare in the Moon now says its New Moon gift lands after the light goes out, so it lasts the cycle.
Dusk-Runner guards the real dark turns (New and Waxing), Giddy Jill lists New 0, and Silverpenny's card is shorter.
